study_description: In-home ethnographic IDIs — kitchen appliance buyers, FMCD category (mixer-grinder, food processor, blender, juicer). No formal DG available; Layer 2 derived from study context and actual extracted data patterns.

layer1.description: Universal fields — identical across all projects

scoring_rules.critical: Explicit deal-breaker — product abandoned, brand never considered again. 3+ reinforcing statements.
scoring_rules.high: Strong unresolved frustration. Required workaround or near-replacement decision. 2+ statements.
scoring_rules.medium: Noted complaint, conditional tolerance. 1-2 mentions, did not trigger switch.
scoring_rules.low: Minor inconvenience. Single passive mention. Does not affect usage or loyalty.

scoring_rules.promoter: Unprompted recommendation to others, repeat purchase intent, emotionally attached. 'I told everyone to buy this brand.'
scoring_rules.passive: Happy but not enthusiastic. Would not proactively recommend. No negative statements.
scoring_rules.detractor: Would warn others against brand. Expresses distrust, disappointment, or active complaint. Considering switch.

scoring_rules.positive: Interview ends on satisfaction, pride, or contentment with product/brand.
scoring_rules.negative: Interview ends on frustration, disappointment, or unresolved issue.
scoring_rules.neutral: Mixed or no strong emotional close.

layer2.description: FMCD ethnographic — kitchen appliance in-home immersion. Layer 2 derived from study context (no formal DG). Based on 233 actual interviews and observed data patterns.

scoring_rules.recent_buyer: Purchased within last 12 months. Purchase decision still salient.
scoring_rules.intender: Planning to buy in next 3-6 months. Actively comparing.
scoring_rules.longtime_user: Using same brand 3+ years. Habitual, low active consideration.

scoring_rules.skilled_cook: Describes cooking with pride. Uses appliance for complex/varied tasks. Identity tied to cooking well.
scoring_rules.practical_cook: Cooking is a daily duty. Uses appliance for efficiency, not joy. No emotional language about cooking.
scoring_rules.aspiring_cook: Wants to cook more ambitiously. Appliance is enabler for aspirations. Follows recipes, new dishes.
scoring_rules.reluctant_cook: Minimal use. Cooking is obligation. Simple tasks only. Appliance underutilised.

scoring_rules.loyal: Repeat purchase intent. Recommends unprompted. Emotional attachment. Multiple years.
scoring_rules.satisfied: No active complaint. Passive recommender. Would likely repurchase.
scoring_rules.strained: One+ unresolved issues. Expressing doubt or frustration. Not actively switching yet.
scoring_rules.at_risk: Considering switch. Significant disappointment. Would not recommend.
scoring_rules.new: First brand purchase. Forming first impressions.

scoring_rules.inherited: Using brand because family always used it. No independent evaluation.
scoring_rules.researched: Actively compared brands, features, price. Made informed independent choice.
scoring_rules.recommended: Chose based on peer, family, or neighbour advice. Trusted word-of-mouth.
scoring_rules.price_driven: Selected on price, offer, or deal. No strong brand pull.
scoring_rules.aspirational: Chose brand for perceived status, modernity, or upgrade aspiration.

scoring_rules.high: Respondent would pay more or switch brand for this. Explicit desire stated.
scoring_rules.medium: Mentioned as desirable, not a blocker or dealmaker.
scoring_rules.low: Passive observation. Would not affect purchase decision.

scoring_rules.high: Frustration, disappointment, or longing expressed. Vocal about the gap.

unspoken_needs.note: Inferred from workarounds and frustrations not directly stated as product requests. E.g., 'rinses jar 3 times before use' → unspoken need: odour-resistant materials

jobs_to_be_done.note: Specific tasks the appliance is hired to do, in respondent's own words

cook_self_image.note: How respondent describes themselves as a cook — direct quote preferred

self_blame_instances.note: Respondent attributes product failure to own misuse. E.g., 'I didn't clean it properly'

product_blame_instances.note: Respondent attributes failure to product or brand. E.g., 'The motor was weak'

scoring_rules.high: Mentioned as reason for purchase, switch, or strong praise. Non-negotiable.
scoring_rules.medium: Noted as desirable, not deciding factor.

narrative_tags.note: Applied in second-pass synthesis, not per-transcript extraction
